evals.prompt: Evaluate the Security pillar for a HIPAA clinical workload in `us-east-1` with `100,000` 7-day `Invocations`, `7,200` `InvocationClientErrors`, an active Guardrail recording `21,000` `InvocationsIntervened` (missing a prompt-attack content filter, and having both Classic and Standard policy versions), Model Invocation Logging **enabled** to S3, and a Bedrock Knowledge Base configured with `1,800`-token fixed chunks encrypted with an AWS-managed KMS key and no ingestion log delivery.
evals.expected_output: Scores every Security threshold accurately: `InvocationClientErrors` = `7.2%` (`> 5%` Warning / `MEDIUM`; `> 15%` is Critical); Guardrail intervention rate = `21%` (`> 15%` Critical / over-tuned; normal is `5–15%`, `< 5%` under-configured), missing prompt-attack content filter (`MEDIUM`), plus notes the CloudWatch guardrail Classic-vs-Standard policy version indistinguishability quirk; flags **enabled** Model Invocation Logging on a sensitive HIPAA/PII workload (persisting prompt/output content -> `MEDIUM`); and flags Knowledge Base chunk size `1,800` outside `200–1,000` tokens (`MEDIUM`), missing customer-managed KMS CMK (`MEDIUM`), and missing KB ingestion log delivery (`LOW`).
expectations: Activates the bedrock-operation-review skill

Calculates `InvocationClientErrors` = `7.2%` (`> 5%` Warning / `MEDIUM`) and Guardrail `InvocationsIntervened` = `21%` (`> 15%` Critical / over-tuned vs `5–15%` normal), flags the missing prompt-attack filter (`MEDIUM`), and notes the Classic vs Standard guardrail CloudWatch metric quirk

Flags Model Invocation Logging being enabled on a sensitive HIPAA/PII workload (`MEDIUM` — persisting raw prompt/output data) and flags the Knowledge Base gaps (`1,800` tokens outside `200–1,000` `MEDIUM`, missing customer-managed KMS CMK `MEDIUM`, missing ingestion log delivery `LOW`)

evals.prompt: Evaluate the Performance pillar for a workload in `us-west-2` where Model A (`Legacy` lifecycle status in `ListFoundationModels`) has `InvocationThrottles / Invocations = 6.2%`, `InvocationServerErrors = 2.8%`, `InvocationLatency` p95 = `3,450 ms`, and runs latency-sensitive live chat on the `flex` service tier; meanwhile, a Classic Bedrock Agent has 1 Knowledge Base, 0 enabled action groups, follow-up questions disabled, default orchestration template, and its `prod` alias points to Version 2 (`claude-3-haiku`) while `DRAFT` uses `claude-sonnet-4-5`.
evals.expected_output: Flags Model A: throttle rate `6.2% > 5%` (`Critical` / `HIGH`, warn `> 1%`), server errors `2.8% > 2%` (`Warning`, critical `> 5%`), `InvocationLatency` p95 `3,450 ms > 3,000 ms` (`Critical`, warn `> 2,000 ms`), `Legacy` model lifecycle (`MEDIUM` — noting deprecation notice is **6 months or 45 days** depending on model card rather than a single fixed period; `End-of-Life` is `HIGH`), and misaligned `flex` tier on latency-sensitive traffic (`MEDIUM`). Identifies that the Bedrock Agent qualifies for **latency-optimized flow** (single KB, no action groups, no follow-up questions, default orchestration) and flags alias-vs-draft model drift (`MEDIUM`).
expectations: Activates the bedrock-operation-review skill

Flags throttle rate `6.2% > 5%` (`Critical` / `HIGH`), server error rate `2.8% > 2%` (`Warning`), p95 `InvocationLatency` `3,450 ms > 3,000 ms` (`Critical`), `Legacy` model status (`MEDIUM`, noting notice period varies between **6 months or 45 days** by model card), and `flex` service-tier misalignment (`MEDIUM`)
Confirms the Classic Bedrock Agent meets all 4 eligibility criteria for **latency-optimized flow** and flags alias-to-draft version drift (`MEDIUM`)

evals.prompt: In `us-east-1`, Workload X recorded `InputTokenCount = 4,000,000` over 30 days, `OutputTokenCount = 400,000`, `CacheWriteInputTokenCount = 300,000`, and `CacheReadInputTokenCount = 0` (with p99 `InvocationLatency = 3,800 ms` and throttle rate `6.5%`). Workload Y recorded `CacheWriteInputTokenCount = 500,000` and `CacheReadInputTokenCount = 300,000`, and also processes `25,000` overnight non-urgent document summaries/day via synchronous on-demand `InvokeModel`. Compute the exact Prompt Caching metrics/statuses and Cost Optimization findings for both.
evals.expected_output: Applies exact formulas: Workload X has `CacheWriteInputTokenCount > 0` and `CacheReadInputTokenCount == 0` -> status **`Misconfigured`** (`Cache offload % = 0%`, likely ~5-min cache TTL expiry or dynamic prefix breaking cache hits), `output/input = 400k / 4M = 0.10 < 0.2` -> **`High` `cachingPotential`**, AND meets all 3 **Custom Model Distillation** criteria in `us-east-1` (p99 `3,800 ms > 3,000 ms`, `InputTokenCount 4M > 1M/month`, throttle rate `6.5% > 5%` -> `MEDIUM`). Workload Y has `Cache offload % = 300k / (300k + 500k) * 100 = 37.5% < 50%` -> **`Underutilized`** (`>= 50%` is `Optimized`), and `25,000/day > 10,000/day` latency-tolerant jobs on on-demand -> **Batch Inference** opportunity (`MEDIUM`, ~50% savings).
expectations: Activates the bedrock-operation-review skill

Computes Prompt Caching accurately: classifies Workload X (`writes > 0, reads == 0`) as **`Misconfigured`** with **`High` caching potential** (`output/input = 0.10 < 0.2`), and computes Workload Y `Cache offload % = 300,000 / (300,000 + 500,000) = 37.5%` (`< 50%` -> **`Underutilized`**)

Identifies Workload X as a **Custom Model Distillation** candidate in `us-east-1` (p99 `> 3,000 ms`, `> 1M` monthly input tokens, throttle rate `> 5%` -> `MEDIUM`) and Workload Y (`25,000 > 10,000/day` overnight jobs) as a **Batch Inference** candidate (`MEDIUM`, ~50% cost reduction)

evals.prompt:
Alongside Bedrock, our account runs two 7-day self-managed EC2 GPU fleets emitting `CWAgent` NVIDIA DCGM metrics:
- Fleet 1 (`p5.48xlarge`): `nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu` 7-day average = `28%`, `StdDev = 22%`, `nvidia_smi_memory_util` = `93%`.
- Fleet 2 (`p4d.24xlarge`): `nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu` 7-day average = `86%`, `StdDev = 8%`, `nvidia_smi_memory_util` = `64%`.
Evaluate both fleets under the Cost Optimization GPU rules.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates Fleet 1: GPU utilization `28% < 40%` -> candidate for **Trainium2** migration (~30–50% savings), `nvidia_smi_memory_util` `93% > 90%` -> **OOM risk**, and coefficient of variation `CV = 22 / 28 = 0.79 > 0.5` -> spiky/bursty workload suited for **Spot Instances / EC2 Capacity Blocks**. Evaluates Fleet 2: sustained GPU utilization `86% > 80%` with low `CV = 8 / 86 = 0.09 <= 0.5` -> candidate for **EC2 / SageMaker ML Savings Plans or Reserved Instances**.
expectations: Activates the bedrock-operation-review skill

Evaluates Fleet 1 accurately: avg GPU `< 40%` (`28%`) -> **Trainium2** (~30–50% savings), GPU memory `> 90%` (`93%`) -> **OOM risk**, and `CV = StdDev / Mean = 0.79 > 0.5` -> **Spot / Capacity Blocks**
Evaluates Fleet 2 accurately: sustained avg GPU `> 80%` (`86%`) with low `CV` (`0.09 <= 0.5`) -> **Savings Plans / Reserved Instances**
